notes.title: Steam Update – New Languages & Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We're continuously working to expand the game’s reach by adding more language options. However, we are committed to maintaining high-quality localization and have chosen [i]not[/i] to rely on AI-generated translations especially for major languages where quality is critical. Instead, we’re hiring human translators and proofreaders through Fiverr, which incurs additional cost but ensures a better experience for players worldwide.[/p][p]In this update, we're excited to roll out [b]Turkish[/b], [b]Italian[/b], and [b]French[/b] language support! We’ve also implemented a series of minor bug fixes and stability improvements based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and as always, more is coming.[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We would like to inform you that we are releasing a small patch for My Bimbo Dream on Steam, which fixes a recently identified issue.

The problem affected some players (5-10% of you), preventing them from starting the game properly. This bug occurred because, in some cases, the game was collecting old data from players who had access to previous test versions, causing conflicts and preventing the game from working as intended.

We are happy to report that this issue has been resolved in the new update, ensuring that new players will no longer encounter this problem.

[b]Important![/b]

For players who are still experiencing this issue, it is essential to follow these steps:

Keep the game open.

- Navigate to the save directory: [i]Steam\steamapps\common\My Bimbo Dream\game\saves[/i]

- Completely delete all files inside that folder.

- Close the game and then open it again.

-- Please note that the game must be open when you delete the save files.

This procedure will ensure that the game works correctly.

We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your understanding and continued support. We are always working to provide the best experience possible!

Sincerely,
The Dev Team

notes.title: My Bimbo Dream – OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
After 2 years of work, My Bimbo Dream - Season 1 is officially out.

This game is a twisted mix of bimbofication, corruption, and branching adult storytelling made with Ren'Py, Daz3D, Blender. It’s unapologetically NSFW, morally messy, and totally ours.

notes.title: Three Days Away
notes.notes:
We’re just three days out from the release of My Bimbo Dream, and honestly? That feels surreal.

This started as a crazy idea—a niche, kinky, unapologetic story about bimbofication, transformation, control, and NTS. But it became more than that. It became our story—shaped by late nights, long builds, internal debates about the ethics of bimbos, and way too many render and animation crashes.

And through all of that, you stuck with us! You liked, commented, wishlisted, DMed. Some of you reached out with real feedback, others just dropped bimbo memes. We needed all of it.
In three days, this thing finally goes live. And we can’t wait to share it with you.

Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579730/My_Bimbo_Dream__Season_1

notes.title: Sue: She Still Thinks of You as Her Boy
notes.notes:
She was always there for you.
Kind. Patient. Soft in every way that mattered.

The kind of woman who made a house feel like home.

But when you move back and find out she is about to get a boob job, something shifts.
Something clicks in a way you didn’t expect.
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/3rspl6.jpg[/img]
You always cared about her—but now you notice her.
The way her new curves fill out those tight tank tops.
The way she leans in just a little closer when she talks to you.
The way she asks what you think of her “new look,” with that familiar, affectionate smile.

You never thought something would ever happen between you two.
It was just a fantasy—sweet, impossible, safe...

But now?

Now she’s teasing. Testing.
And maybe—just maybe—inviting something more.

So… how far are you going to push it?
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/w0mrbl.jpg[/img]
And how far is she willing to go?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579730/My_Bimbo_Dream__Season_1

notes.title: Lucia: Temptation in a Tight Dress
notes.notes:
Growing up with this woman constantly around? Torture.
Trying to survive puberty while she strutted around the house, all curves and confidence… it was brutal.

But now you're an adult—and it’s clear just how much of a handful she really is.
Her husband’s barely ever home, and the way she sleeps around… there’s no way he knows. Or maybe he just pretends not to. Not that it’s your business.
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/s4rs9i.png[/img]

At least, it wouldn’t be—if she didn’t keep inserting herself into your life.
Her questions. Her teasing.
That cleavage.
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/aasnym.jpg[/img]
Yeah. It’s getting really hard to ignore her.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579730/My_Bimbo_Dream__Season_1

notes.title: Breaking Up Was the Easy Part
notes.notes:
Damn, she was hot.
You really thought you’d hit the jackpot when she agreed to go out with you. Sure, you were obsessed with bimbos—but honestly? Scarlet came pretty damn close to that ideal… and she was all natural.
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/t2w43j.png[/img]
It was just a pity she got so boring.

Maybe it was your doubts about your art course.
Or maybe it was the way she stopped putting in any effort—like she was taking you for granted.
Whatever the reason, it felt like the spark was gone. And it was time to break up.

Still… what if she meant it when she said she wanted to change?
What if she finally realized there was a sexual side of herself she hadn’t even touched before?
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/sge3ei.jpg[/img]
Well… in that case…

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579730/My_Bimbo_Dream__Season_1

notes.title: Introducing：Megan
notes.notes:
You remember those girls from school—the ones who could cut you down with a smirk and a sentence. Always gorgeous, always sharp-tongued… and somehow, always in control.

Megan was definitely one of them.

She had that perfect blend of bitchy and beautiful—the kind of girl who could wreck your self-esteem and make you thank her for it. But damn… she was cute. And under all that sass and side-eye, there was something else. A spark. Maybe even a smile, if you looked close enough.
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/kxfivm.png[/img]
People like her… sometimes they build walls to keep worse things out. Maybe she wasn’t just mean—maybe she was just defensive. Maybe, just maybe, she deserved a second chance.

And now? She’s older. Hotter. Still sharp as ever—but she’s got this perky, flirty side when she lets her guard down.

Oh… and that massive box in the corner? The one labeled TOYS?
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/zj00sx.jpg[/img]
Well. That might explain a lot.

notes.title: Two Years, Ten Episodes, One Bimbo Dream
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

If you're new here, welcome. After more than two years of development, we’re finally entering the home stretch. And let us tell you... it’s looking hotter and more polished than ever. Over time, we’ve leveled up our animation, graphics, programming, and storytelling—and we really think the results are starting to show.

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/ckb95k.gif[/img]

What started as a small niche project has grown into something much bigger. Thanks to the incredible support from our subscribers and community, we’ve gone from a friendly team of just 3 to a core team of 7—plus several amazing fan translators, artists, and proofreaders helping us bring the game to life around the world.

Season 1 includes 10 full episodes and over 18 hours of content if you explore all the routes and kinks. Some paths might be too extreme for some players, others too tame for the hardcore crowd. That’s why we priced the game based on the average length of a single-route playthrough—around 6 to 8 hours.

[b]Don’t forget to [i]Wishlist [/i]and [i]follow [/i]us for future updates.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579730?utm_campaign=POST0403_MBD

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/NnJ8pdKzQs]Discord[/url] to chat with us devs and share your ideas and feedback.

notes.title: Team and Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have some exciting updates to share about the team and the progress on the game!

First, we’re thrilled to announce two new additions to the team who are already making a big impact Eroguysensei and Drive. Eroguysensei is focusing on creating and polishing the main environments of the game for Season 2 as well as create renders for S2EP1. He’s adding detail and perfecting the overall look of the game, which is already improving the visual quality. Meanwhile, Drive is working on rigging and animations, transferring assets from Daz3D to Maya to make the animations more professional and smooth. Their combined expertise is helping us take the game to the next level.

On the development side, the posing for Episode 10 Part 2 is nearly finished thanks to Cus, who has been doing a fantastic job. There’s still some work left to do, but the finale is really coming together. At the same time, work on Season 2 Episode 1 is already underway, and the first renders are coming through. It feels a bit strange to see the start of a new season before finishing the last, but the goal is to release both around the same time — aiming for the end of April/Start of May.

We’re excited about the direction things are heading, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

More updates coming soon!

Jim and Sinburn

notes.title: Developers Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We’re hard at work on Episode 9 of My Bimbo Dream, which will be available to our Patrons next month. This episode is the second to last in the season, so get ready for some major developments as we approach the season finale and the Steam release!

In addition, we’ve been going back to rework some of the early game images to ensure a more cohesive visual style throughout. This includes redone animations, and we’re incredibly proud of the improvements—everything feels smoother and more polished. We can’t wait for you all to experience the enhanced visuals for the steam release!

notes.title: Development Update: Season 1... What will it include?
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share some details about our progress and plans for the game’s upcoming Steam release!

[b]Season 1[/b] of the game will include all episodes from 1 to 10, giving you a complete experience from start to finish. In preparation for the Steam release, Episodes 1-3 will undergo a complete revamp, including improved visuals (renders + animations) and additional scenes to enrich the overall experience. These updates are going to be specifically for the Steam version, so the early game will feel fresh and more polished than ever.

As for this month on patreon, we’ll be releasing Episode 8. Overall, we’re currently about 60-65% through the game’s development. Our focus is on polishing the game as much as possible before launching it on Steam, ensuring that it meets our high standards.

Thank you,

- The team
